data.text: I've reviewed the code and tests and every scenario holds, so I'm writing an empty findings file.

All five scenarios hold, so I wrote `{"findings": []}` to `openspec/changes/323-rust-report-history-counts/.run/validator/findings.json`. I checked this by reading the code, tests and goldens. As instructed, I ran no build, test or git command.

- **History of the history project:** the code is in `crates/features/report/src/report/history.rs`, `history_text.rs` and `history_json.rs`. `tests/report_history.rs` checks the text and JSON against the new `history-project` goldens. It also checks each line the scenario lists, including `    claude-opus: 1`, `    Requeued for agent: 1` and the exact `perSpec` string. Before this change the report had no History section, so this test would fail on the base code.
- **Reported cost texts:** the code is `js_number::reported_cost`, and `perSpec` drops any spec whose total isn't above zero. `reported_cost_texts` covers all five rows from the table, plus two extra rows (0.01 and 100). Working through the rounding by hand gives the expected text for each row, including `$-0.5000`.
- **Report summary equals TypeScript's:** the existing goldens now include the History section, and the new `history-project` case is in `report_summary.rs`. All of them differ from what the base code prints, so the test would fail on the base.
- **Task histories:** the code is the new `read_task_history` in `crates/kernel/storage/src/read/task_history/`. `tests/reading_task_history.rs` covers every row of the table with the expected `TaskHistory` values. This function didn't exist before the change.
- **Rejection planners:** the code is the new `read_rejection_planner`. It trims the planner name and gives `unknown` when the brief has no planner text. `tests/reading_rejection_planner.rs` covers all six rows.

The patch also contains unrelated work, probably brought in by the main sync: land cleanup, a git identity for the run worktree tests, and a sync refusal while a watcher runs (the source of the `tests/vcs-sync-command.test.ts` change). None of it is in the scenarios list, so I didn't judge it.
